title: Trustworthy pre-merge gate: unflake the blockers, catch the classes production caught
gate: Decision #474: GitHub Actions is on again, so the eight required contexts report and the decision #465 --admin bypass is not used. This mission changes no runtime code: only frontend specs, the vitest config and one new backend integration test.
scope_note: Chartered for 'the two CommandPalette specs'. The 20-run soak found FOUR specs failing in THREE distinct ways; all four were fixed, because any one of them makes a green pre-merge run meaningless (learning #207).

commandpalette_20_consecutive_runs.evidence: 20 consecutive FULL vitest runs on the final tree: 20 green, 0 red, 0 CommandPalette spec failures. The criterion asked only that the two specs pass; the whole 239-test suite passed all 20 times.
commandpalette_20_consecutive_runs.before: Same soak on the pre-fix tree produced red runs 1, 2 and 3 of 12 across three different files.
commandpalette_20_consecutive_runs.waits: Timers are driven, not awaited: the 200 ms debounce is advanced with vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync inside act, then assertions read a settled tree. No findBy remains in the file.

table_390px_gate.evidence: The assertion added by #324 (frontend/tests/e2e/app-shell.spec.ts) was verified as a real gate rather than assumed. On the pre-#324 MarkdownRenderer the 'Applicability conditions' column measures 48.40625 px against a >90 px assertion, and region.scrollWidth > clientWidth is false. Each half was shown to fail INDEPENDENTLY, so the gate does not rest on one magic number. Green on main.

row_locking_on_real_postgres.audit: All six with_for_update call sites were audited against the four lazy="joined" relationships. Two are the outer-join defect class; four are not (no eager-joined relationship on the locked entity).

sites.app/services/collection.py:235: not the class (Collection has no eager-joined relationship)
sites.app/services/collection.py:261: not the class (inner join, no eager-joined relationship)
sites.app/services/synthesis_cache.py:108,230: not the class (SynthesisCache has no relationships at all)

red_then_green: notifications: reverting with_for_update(of=Mission) to a bare lock fails with psycopg2.errors.FeatureNotSupported: FOR UPDATE cannot be applied to the nullable side of an outer join; restored, passes.
collection: reverting with_for_update(of=CollectionItem) to a bare lock fails with the same production error; restored, passes.

eight_required_contexts_green.result: met: all eight required contexts passed on PR #328, plus the non-required mcp-package

root_causes: jsdom charges 50-120 ms per Testing Library role+name lookup (first in a worker ~0.7 s), so a 1 s findBy spent its whole budget on one or two attempts. Fixed by driving the debounce and asserting a settled tree.

Three specs (CommandPalette, mission-authoring, document-upload) legitimately exceeded the 5 s default testTimeout once vitest runs files in parallel. Fixed with testTimeout: 30_000 - budget, not a wait.
admin/users asserted the confirm dialog was gone one commit before Dialog's closing useEffect ran. Fixed by waiting for the dismissal being asserted.
mutation_verification: Drop the late-close guard in CommandPalette -> the reopen spec fails.
Search the untrimmed query instead of the trimmed term -> the entity-link spec fails.
Make Dialog never close -> the admin/users spec fails.

Re-key EntityGroup by entity type only -> NO spec fails, but this is an equivalent mutant, not a coverage gap: the page reset is enforced by the loading state unmounting the group, confirmed by the spec's own not.toHaveBeenCalledWith("Second","document",2) assertion. The pre-existing spec behaves identically.

local_verification.integration_suite: 138 passed, 4 skipped in 280 s (local testcontainers Postgres)
local_verification.playwright: 390 px table spec green on main; red on the reverted renderer
local_verification.ruff: clean on the new test file
local_verification.secret_scan: clean on the new test file
local_verification.type_check_and_lint: both clean after clearing stale .next (see learning #212)

not_in_scope: A phone-width sweep across every content-sized table belongs to A11Y-1, which owns the automated overflow checks across the 36 baseline routes. VERIFY-1 verified the one gate next-step #344 named.
limitations: The 20-run soak ran on one machine (darwin, local). It demonstrates determinism under that machine's load, not across CI runner classes.
testTimeout: 30_000 means a genuinely hung spec now takes 30 s rather than 5 s to fail. Accepted: the full suite runs in ~80 s and a random red costs more than a slow red.
mission-authoring and document-upload were fixed by the timeout change alone; unlike CommandPalette their waits were already promise-driven, so no spec-level change was needed or made.
